A few fair questions.

Is this just an AI chat app?

No. NUFI is the programme and meal-planning system. Jeff and Steff help you use it. Courses support the experience; they are not the whole product.

Do I have to buy supplements?

No. The shop is optional. Plain protein and flavour shots are separate products, not a condition of using NUFI.

Do I get a human personal trainer?

Do not assume one-to-one coaching is included. Human support, community access and any live sessions must be confirmed in the final offer. Jeff and Steff are AI.

Can I try this website?

Yes. You can explore the onboarding outline, build a basket and preview a subscription. None of that creates a real account, payment or personalised health plan.
